char_103_angel.normal: Source default direct ranged Physical, single air-priority legal victim, CAST0, Attack event.3, animation cap2. No invented normal projectile.
char_103_angel.S1: Source next-attack selected3 rounds, cap1 original Attack event.3, selected each-shot atk_scale, independent triggerDelta.05; speed30 lifetime5 projectiles. Dead input can recover one pending charge only when no shot was emitted; replacement/born/control boundaries distinct.
char_103_angel.S2: Manual duration15, selected4 rounds/per-shot scale, shared native Attack/cap2 and .05 additional releases. No unmapped skill animation.
char_103_angel.S3: AUTO duration15, selected5 rounds/per-shot scale. Two native attr8/formula0/loadFromBlackboard1 modifiers map to two selected additive BAT deltas, independently corroborated by pinned calculator. M3 base1+2*(-.11)=.78 before ASPD/other BAT buckets.
char_103_angel.Talent1: Selected E1/E2/potential additive ASPD; no generic duplicate.
char_103_angel.Talent2: Selected self ATK/HP percentages and one seeded legal already-deployed operator within native radius30 at deployment. Non-HEAL purposeNONE/ignoreHealFree1 preserves unhealable recipients; ignoreTargetFree1 does not exclude enemy-target-free states; allied isolation/death/disappearance/removal detaches only owned selected recipient. No invented later replacement.
char_103_angel.burstLifecycle: Initial CAST victim retained through additional rounds; original interruptAbilityOnDetach0 preserves already-started selected burst after skill mode expires. Owner lifetime/control epoch invalidate unborn rounds; born projectiles source-invalid0 retain impact.

limitations: The original C# blackboard loader and the source default versus selected override for each S3 BAT field are not executable-recovered. Exact original two loadFromBlackboard entries and independent pinned calculator doubling are retained, with the runtime 2*selectedBB mapping explicitly corroborated rather than claimed native dispatcher proof.

Original timeMode0/cap2 animation playback is interpreted from baseBAT/current interval, capped by the exact source value; S1 cap1 is distinct. Native dynamic retiming/clip end ordering is not recovered.

Original triggerDelta .05/waitAttackEventForAllAttacks0 is preserved as a fixed additional release interval. Native between-round target reselection, attack/SP event multiplicity and end-of-cast dispatch are unrecovered; one completed attack event and one SP/charge lifecycle are retained.

Primary Global wording establishes a random ally on deployment. Exact native PRNG/order and whether selected-recipient departure permits later replacement are unrecovered; adapter makes one seeded deploy choice and does not invent continuous replacement. Native radius30/default/category/profession/isolation/removal fields are retained.

Native noncached projectile damage uses current source ATK after release; selected attack profile remains retained across skill mode expiry/source withdrawal. Exact clone/late modifier dispatch, HP buff insertion ordering and all Unity particle/audio effects remain unverified.
